text:
maya: Heads-up — since 07:42 we're seeing a cluster of tiny 1gpu jobs stuck Pending in us-east1c. Lots of single-GPU holes across racks even though overall GPU utilization is low. Anyone digging?
oscar: I saw alerts. packing_hole_detector shows ~35 holes in last 20m. Scheduler logs contain repeated 'pod didn't match topologySpreadConstraint' and 'taint gpu:reserved present'.
lee: ran `kubectl describe` on a sample pod: shows topologySpread hard requirement across zone and rack + no toleration for `gpu.reserved=warm:NoSchedule`. Several nodes are marked Ready but with taints from warmpool controller.
maya: also noticed intermittent NIC egress errors on a subset of racks — could be causing transient node NotReady flaps earlier, which made scheduler aggressively spread. ops-bot: incident: network_rack_r3_egress spike -> 07:15-07:28 (recovered).
oscar: two fold issue then: 1) strict spread + scheduler anti-affinity led to scattering tiny jobs, leaving 1-GPU slots, 2) warm-reserve taints block backfill. Short fixes: add a toleration for warm-reserve on best-effort queue; change topologySpreadConstraint from Hard->Prefer for the queue; enable scheduler coalescing window 5m for tiny requests.
pat: cost & reliability tradeoff note: allowing warm-reserve tolerations for low-priority jobs will increase reserved util by ~0.5% but reduces schedule latency and avoids cascading evictions. Acceptable?
lee: propose canary: patch low-priority queue in us-east1c only, 15 pods. Commands I will use: `kubectl patch deployment low-priority-queue -n infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"gpu.reserved","operator":"Equal","value":"warm","effect":"NoSchedule","tolerationSeconds":3600}]}}}}'` then `kubectl patch deployment low-priority-queue -n infra -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"topologySpreadConstraints":[{"maxSkew":1,"topologyKey":"rack","whenUnsatisfiable":"PreferDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution"}]}}}}'`
oscar: I'll watch metrics: packing_hole_rate_us-east1c, schedule_latency_p99, eviction_count. If packing_hole_rate drops >60% and schedule_latency p99 improves within 10m, we keep. If eviction_count spikes > 20/min, revert immediately. ops-bot: scheduled watcher set for 10m.
maya: applying canary now. Rolling to 15 pods in us-east1c.
pat: add runbook note: if NIC errors repeat, roll back to strict spread to avoid correlated rack failures. Also add a short-term cron job to run compacting descheduler every 15m to coalesce single-gpu holes into contiguous free GPUs for gang jobs.
lee: FYI we should also consider changing scheduler scoring to prefer filling nodes with <2 free GPUs first to avoid many 1-GPU holes. Longer term item.
oscar: canary applied. monitoring...
